description: Use this when a witnessed delivery failed and you must hand the facts to the other party or a resolver. Pass `terms_id` or a delivery `receipt_id`. Returns one hash-stamped bundle: terms, every check, receipts, timeline, summary. No judgement of who is right. Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be public and non-personal.

continuity_handle.description: Optional: the continuity_handle that registered a DELIVERY_SLA watch on these terms; adds your SLA breaches.

receipt_format.description: gaip (default) or x402_sar: also give each delivery in the x402 SAR draft shape.

terms_id.description: Or the terms_id (wt_...) of the agreement.

name: witness_dispute_bundle
title: Export a delivery evidence bundle
